description: Solo participant working on a space mission design concept.
summary:
I developed Project Orbitalsweeper, a fleet-based laser system designed to safely destroy falling space debris over Point Nemo, the most remote area of the ocean.

My solution uses a coordinated group of 4 to 6 ships equipped with high-energy lasers. Instead of firing continuously and overheating, the lasers fire short, 2-second pulses to break down re-entering spacecraft and satellites into harmless dust before they hit the water.

This project is important because falling space junk threatens ships, aviation, and marine ecosystems with toxic waste. Orbitalsweeper turns dangerous, uncontrolled space debris re-entries into a safe and clean process.
details: Project Orbitalsweeper is an advanced orbital debris mitigation system designed to safely compromise and destabilize spacecraft and rocket components re-entering Earth's atmosphere over Point Nemo.How It Works:The system utilizes a coordinated fleet of 1 to 3 vessels (and scalable higher) equipped with high-energy laser turrets. Instead of continuous-wave beams that cause severe thermal overheating or vaporizing the debris into dust, our architecture employs synchronized 2-second micro-pulses. This induces targeted thermal shock to structurally damage and weaken the falling hardware, ensuring controlled disintegration along safe atmospheric trajectories before ocean impact.Tools & Technology:Developed using engineering calculations thermodynamic modeling, and AI-assisted generation tools utilized for creating project demonstrations and visual assets.
